title: AI-First Drug Design: Accelerating the Discovery of New Therapeutics - Isomorphic Labs
content: In this Flash Talk, our Head of Medicinal Chemistry, Rebecca Paul shares her insights on how Isomorphic Labs is applying breakthrough AI models to advance the rational design and optimisation of small molecules. Presented by Rebecca Paul, Ph.D. with host Dennis Koester, Ph.D. Director of Industry Research and Relations, Drug Hunter.
